scripts.dev: vp run wasm#build && vp run --parallel -F web -F server dev
scripts.dev:desktop: vp run wasm#build && vp run --parallel -F web -F server -F desktop dev
scripts.start:desktop: vp run -r build && vp run desktop#start
scripts.package:desktop: vp run -F web... -F desktop build && vp run desktop#package
scripts.ready: vp check && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && vp run -r test && vp run -r build
